name: git-hosting
purpose: Optional issue and pull/merge request metadata for the selected hosting system.
upstream: project-selected GitLab or GitHub MCP implementation
setup_steps: Select the actual GitLab or GitHub host
Provide a least-privilege local token reference and keep write/merge tools disabled by default
health_check: MCP initialize and tools/list; a metadata read requires separate host approval
corrective_action: Select one hosting provider and pin its official/reviewed server. Local Git remains available without this integration.
permissions: Metadata reads by default; creating or merging changes requires explicit human authorization.
